description: Taseli's weekly read of the competitors: the week in one sentence and up to 5 ideas (offer, price, long runners, format, channel, hook, audience, language, gaps, strengths), each with what changed, why it matters, how sure Taseli is, the competitor ads it cites as evidence (ad ids), the one suggested action and whether the owner acted on it. `id` returns one idea. Useful for 'what should I do about my competitors?', 'what changed in the market this week?'.

id.description: One idea by its id (e.g. the one on screen).

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

status.description: Open ideas only (default), or also acted on and dismissed ones.

name: get_market_insights

error.description: Why nothing was done, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Ideas from the competitors
